name: CKEditor 5 - Dark Mode plugin
description: Adds a button to CKEditor 5 to switch the editor between light and dark theme.
project_description:
Features 
 This module is a plugin in addition to CKEditor5, simply allowing to set up a Dark Mode button to switch between light theme and dark theme.

 This plugin could be necessary if you're also using CKEditor 5 - Font Plugin (Text Color, Background Color) or CKEditor Font Size and Family with a white text color available, to make them visible avoiding the white background.

 

 Post-Installation 
 In /admin/config/content/formats, add the Dark Mode button to your CKEditor 5 text formats to make it available in rich text editors.
